flagHints.TOO_EASY: Almost everyone answers correctly, so the question does not separate students.
flagHints.TOO_HARD: Very few students answer correctly. Check the answer key or the question wording.
flagHints.LOW_DISCRIMINATION: Top and bottom groups perform almost the same.
flagHints.NEGATIVE_DISCRIMINATION: The bottom group outperforms the top group; the key may be wrong or the question misleading.

legend.title: How to read the indices
legend.p: P = proportion answering correctly. P ≥ 0.8: easy; P ≤ 0.3: hard.
legend.d: D = P(top 27% group) − P(bottom 27% group). D ≥ 0.4: good; 0.2–0.4: fair; 0–0.2: low; < 0: negative.
